title: Arm Lift Malaysia by Specialist Plastic Surgeon | Remove Loose Upper Arm Skin Safely – Dr. Soma
description: Looking for safe, surgeon-performed arm lift (brachioplasty) in Malaysia? Dr. Soma offers advanced body contouring to remove excess upper arm skin for firmer, toned arms.

acceptedAnswer.text: An arm lift is a surgical procedure that removes excess loose skin and, if needed, fat from the upper arms. It creates a more toned, contoured appearance, particularly for patients who have lost significant weight or developed skin laxity due to ageing.

mainEntity.name: Who is a good candidate for arm lift surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideal candidates include adults with sagging upper-arm skin that causes discomfort or self-consciousness, those at a stable weight, non-smokers (or willing to stop), individuals without medical conditions that impair healing, and people with realistic expectations about outcomes and scars.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an arm lift and liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Liposuction removes excess fat but does not address loose skin. An arm lift removes redundant skin and tightens the remaining tissue. In some cases, both procedures are combined for optimal contouring.

mainEntity.name: How long does arm lift surgery take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, the surgery takes 2–3 hours, depending on the extent of skin removal and whether liposuction is performed simultaneously.

mainEntity.name: What kind of anaesthesia is used?

acceptedAnswer.text: General anaesthesia is usually recommended. The specifics will be discussed during your consultation with Dr. Soma.

mainEntity.name: What is the expected recovery time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients can return to desk-based work within 1–2 weeks. Strenuous activities, heavy lifting, and upper-body exercise are generally restricted for 4–6 weeks. Final contour becomes more visible at 3–6 months.

Yes — the removed skin will not return. However, maintaining a stable weight and following a healthy lifestyle is essential to preserve results.

mainEntity.name: Can an arm lift be combined with other procedures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Arm lifts can be combined with breast surgery, liposuction, tummy tucks, or other body contouring procedures as part of a comprehensive body reshaping plan.

mainEntity.name: Is arm lift surgery safe in Malaysia?

acceptedAnswer.text: When performed by a registered, board-certified plastic surgeon in a licensed healthcare facility — like Dr. Soma — arm lift surgery adheres to national medical standards. Dr. Soma operates under full monitoring protocols with a focus on patient safety.
